_comment: One candidate record inside a discovery-shortlist.json. Start every candidate from this file.

_enums._comment: The checker reads these vocabularies from here rather than restating them, so a new state is a contract edit and the two cannot drift apart. recommendation_state is deliberately the same ladder render_final_trip_html.py enforces on the Construction side -- one word means one thing across both modes.

eligibility._comment: hard_filter_status is the verdict every downstream reader trusts. 'unknown' is the honest default of an unfilled record, and it is never a pass -- a candidate recommended while carrying it was recommended without a filter. 'not_pursued' is the declared, non-demoting alternative: the constraint has a subject here but researching it would buy nothing, and not_pursued_reason says what was skipped. That is a different statement from 'nobody looked', and conflating the two is what makes a coverage rule fire on correct work.

cost_estimate._comment: cost_basis travels with the figure rather than being declared once at the top of the document, because a single shared declaration cannot be contradicted by anything: a figure priced for the whole party lands under a per-person heading with no field able to disagree with it.
